pattern: はそっちのけで / をそっちのけで
aliases: wa socchinoke de / o socchinoke de
purpose: Describe neglecting something while concentrating elsewhere.
keywords: N + は / を + そっちのけで
He ignored his homework and played games.
The staff chatted among themselves, ignoring the customers.
I worked on the model, even neglecting meals.
formation: N + は / を + そっちのけで
restrictions: Often refers to work, a duty, or another person being ignored.
mistake: It is stronger than simply doing two things at different times.
